population: Accepted base plus quarantine rows with exact 10-digit raw APNs
query:
WITH identified AS (
SELECT source_object_id,apn_norm FROM parcel_v2_rehearsal.parcel_base_sangis_v2
UNION ALL SELECT source_object_id,apn_raw FROM parcel_v2_rehearsal.rejection WHERE apn_raw ~ '^[0-9]{10}$'
), repeated AS (SELECT apn_norm,count(*) n,count(DISTINCT source_object_id) ids FROM identified GROUP BY apn_norm HAVING count(*)>1)
SELECT json_build_object('groups',count(*),'rows',sum(n),'groupsWithMultipleSourceObjectIds',count(*) FILTER(WHERE ids>1)) FROM repeated
geometryEvidence: rejection-review.json from checksum-verified raw artifact, not repaired/quarantine geometry imported into the base
